Soybean Products
High oleic soybeans bring exciting potential for boosting both economic and nutritional value on dairy farms. With flexible feeding options, we’re here to help you explore how high oleic soybeans can fit into your farm’s strategy and make an impact.

ABOUT
Exceller is a brand of soybean feed ingredients produced by Quality Roasting, a trusted name in the feed industry since 1991. Since our start in Valders, Wisconsin, we’ve expanded our footprint, setting up multiple manufacturing sites to meet the need for high quality soy products.
